Add home screen widget with configurable feed

Scrollable widget showing HN stories with tap-to-open support.
Users pick a feed type (Top/New/Best/Ask/Show/Jobs) via a config
activity when adding the widget. Each widget instance stores its
own feed independently. Tapping a link story opens the article
webview; tapping a text story opens comments. Refresh button shows
a spinning progress indicator while loading, with a compact
timestamp ("now", "5m", "2h") in the header. Custom skeleton
loading placeholder replaces the default "Loading..." text.

Fix widget resource leaks, shared state, and error handling

- Close OkHttp response bodies with try-with-resources
- Use per-widget last_updated key so instances track timestamps independently
- Refresh only the tapped widget instead of all widgets
- Use unique PendingIntent request codes per widget
- Clean up SharedPreferences on widget deletion
- Show error state when fetch fails instead of silent empty list

Redesign Settings into multi-screen navigation with two-pane foldable support

Split the single flat preferences scroll (~50 items) into 6 category
sub-screens: Appearance, Stories, Web & Links, Comments, Filters & Tags,
and Data & Storage.

- Add SettingsHeaderFragment as the main category list
- Add BaseSettingsFragment with shared toolbar, inset handling, and utilities
- Add SettingsCallback interface for fragment-to-activity communication
- Add runtime two-pane detection via WindowMetricsCalculator (600dp threshold)
- Support fold/unfold transitions with fragment migration between panes
- Add selection highlight in header list for two-pane mode
- Persist navigation state across process death
- Handle back navigation correctly in both single and two-pane modes
- Add configChanges flags for foldable screenLayout changes
- Delete monolithic root_preferences.xml, replace with 7 focused XML files

Improve widget styling, fix refresh loop, and address review feedback

- Restyle widget config screen to match app patterns (ScrollView, Material
  radio buttons, themed colors, CTA-style confirm button)
- Add widget picker preview with dummy stories for light and dark themes
- Reduce story index width and respect app's "Show story indices" setting,
  updating the widget when the preference changes
- Fix infinite onDataSetChanged loop caused by partiallyUpdateAppWidget
  triggering the framework to re-query the adapter; UI updates are now
  posted to the main handler with a skip_fetch flag that persists until
  the provider explicitly clears it before a deliberate refresh
- Fix spurious config-change re-render after process restart by
  initializing lastNightMode from current config on first onReceive
- Fetch into a temporary list and swap on success so the widget keeps
  showing stale data during refresh instead of going blank
- Fix refresh icon invisible in light mode (use themed color)
- Add dark mode variant for loading placeholder shimmer
- Reset empty text to "Loading stories…" on refresh start
- Add configChanges to WidgetConfigActivity to preserve state on rotation
- Make skip_fetch flag per-widget to avoid race conditions

Settings multi-screen fixes and polish

- Add close icon to Settings header toolbar
- Fix fragment transaction safety during fold/unfold transition
- Fix potential NPE in bookmark export Snackbar
- Extract DEFAULT_KEY constant to avoid duplicated strings

Fixed color tinting for day/night mode

Widgets are a little finnicky in that they dont get an update when we switch between day/night mode so it's better to let the xml handle all of the tinting
